measurement_policy.sample_policy: Run the declared minimum after one discarded setup run; retain every raw sample, tool version, manifest identity, and environment fingerprint.
measurement_policy.variance_policy: Report median, p95, range, and coefficient of variation; instability above ten percent requires investigation and cannot be hidden by averaging.
measurement_policy.regression_policy: Compare like-for-like immutable manifests; a five-percent regression requires review and a budget breach blocks the owning gate regardless of baseline movement.
measurement_policy.exception_policy: A waiver must name one metric and profile, explain user impact, identify mitigation and owner, expire within one release, and never convert missing evidence into a pass.
measurement_policy.freshness_policy: Release evidence must be reproduced for the candidate manifest on governed environments within thirty days and after any relevant runtime, renderer, asset, or build change.

budgets.subject: clean production browser-profile build
budgets.measurement_method: Time a dependency-cached clean profile build with immutable inputs and retain phase timing plus the output manifest.

budgets.subject: normalized renderer update to committed DOM paint
budgets.measurement_method: Replay the governed keyed-update fixture and measure renderer receipt through the next painted frame with browser tracing.

budgets.subject: local normalized event through visible paint
budgets.measurement_method: Dispatch the governed local action fixture and correlate normalized event, component update, renderer commit, and painted frame timestamps.

budgets.subject: authenticated server command through acknowledged result
budgets.measurement_method: Execute the governed authenticated command against a deterministic regional server fixture and retain client/server correlation timestamps.

budgets.subject: minimal application code compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Build the governed minimal application and sum Brotli-compressed application-owned chunks from the content-addressed manifest.

budgets.subject: minimal application decoded bytes
budgets.measurement_method: Build the governed minimal application and sum decoded application-owned chunks from the content-addressed manifest.

budgets.subject: optional chart package compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Build the chart-only feature fixture and sum newly reachable Brotli-compressed code and default chart assets.

budgets.subject: optional data package compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Build the data-only feature fixture and sum newly reachable Brotli-compressed runtime-heavy package chunks.

budgets.subject: one optional component-family bundle compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Compare minimal and single-family content-addressed manifests and sum only newly reachable Brotli-compressed chunks and assets.

budgets.subject: default fonts and icons compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Sum first-view font and icon assets from the production manifest after subsetting and Brotli compression.

budgets.subject: browser loader and bootstrap compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Sum production loader and bootstrap chunks exactly as transferred with Brotli compression and source maps excluded.

budgets.subject: AtomVM and runtime support compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Sum the pinned runtime Wasm, standard-library bytecode, and required support chunks under production Brotli settings.

budgets.subject: shared UI foundation compressed transfer
budgets.measurement_method: Sum Brotli-compressed semantic tree, renderer contract, tokens, theme, and F0 foundation chunks in the minimal UI fixture.

budgets.subject: publicly deployable production source maps
budgets.measurement_method: Inspect the deployable manifest and public asset tree; private symbol artifacts may exist only outside the public deployment set.

budgets.subject: per-root normalized event backlog
budgets.measurement_method: Drive the overload fixture above consumer rate and assert bounded admission, explicit coalescing or rejection, and retained ordering traces.

budgets.subject: pending effects per root
budgets.measurement_method: Drive delayed and denied capability fixtures while recording effect admission, timeout, cancellation, and cleanup transitions.

budgets.subject: network restoration through reconciled application state
budgets.measurement_method: Interrupt and restore the governed connection fixture and measure detection, authenticated reconnect, state reconciliation, and user-visible completion.

budgets.subject: queued renderer transactions per root
budgets.measurement_method: Drive producer-over-renderer overload and retain queue depth, coalescing, backpressure, rejection, and generation-order traces.

budgets.subject: simultaneously leased resources per root
budgets.measurement_method: Drive the resource-heavy fixture while inventorying every lease by owner, kind, generation, acquisition, release, and terminal state.

budgets.subject: automatic runtime or component-boundary restarts within five seconds
budgets.measurement_method: Inject persistent deterministic failure and assert restart admission, five-second intensity accounting, terminal stop, diagnostics, and fallback.

budgets.subject: automatic retries for one authorized idempotent operation
budgets.measurement_method: Inject deterministic transient failures and assert policy authorization, idempotency key reuse, bounded backoff, cancellation, and terminal reporting.

budgets.subject: concurrent independent roots per browser runtime
budgets.measurement_method: Mount, update, move, dispose, and remount independent governed roots while checking one runtime, isolation, responsiveness, and cleanup.

budgets.subject: stale generation renderer and effect messages rejected
budgets.measurement_method: Replay randomized delayed prior-generation renderer and effect messages and assert every one is rejected without state mutation.

budgets.subject: root disposal through resource release
budgets.measurement_method: Dispose the governed resource-heavy root and measure through idempotent release of subscriptions, timers, surfaces, files, and effect handles.

budgets.subject: retained memory after one hundred root lifecycle cycles
budgets.measurement_method: After stabilization, execute one hundred mount-use-dispose cycles, force supported collection points, and compare retained runtime/browser memory.

budgets.subject: live BEAM process growth after one hundred root lifecycle cycles
budgets.measurement_method: Compare supervised live-process inventories before and after one hundred mount-use-dispose cycles once expected persistent services are excluded.

budgets.subject: cold navigation through interactive first root on desktop
budgets.measurement_method: Navigate with cold HTTP and compilation caches and correlate navigation start, asset completion, runtime readiness, root registration, and interactive paint.

budgets.subject: cold navigation through interactive first root on mobile
budgets.measurement_method: Navigate with cold HTTP and compilation caches and correlate navigation start, asset completion, runtime readiness, root registration, and interactive paint.

budgets.subject: runtime parse compilation and instantiation
budgets.measurement_method: Instrument runtime bytes available through initialized AtomVM instance while retaining browser compilation-cache state and runtime identity.

budgets.subject: runtime ready through interactive registered root
budgets.measurement_method: Register a governed root against an already-ready runtime and correlate registration, initial component evaluation, renderer commit, and interactive paint.

budgets.subject: warm navigation through interactive first root on desktop
budgets.measurement_method: Navigate with warm HTTP and compilation caches and correlate navigation start, runtime readiness, root registration, and interactive paint.

failure_scenarios.trigger: required or optional capability grant is denied
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Apply the classified family fallback, preserve an accessible path, disclose denial without leaking host details, and release provisional resources.

failure_scenarios.trigger: component evaluation raises or violates its contract
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Contain failure to the governed boundary, render an accessible fallback, preserve sibling roots, report diagnostics, and dispose owned resources.

failure_scenarios.trigger: manifest, protocol, schema, asset, or deployment identities disagree
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse partial activation, preserve server or static content, disclose a bounded diagnostic, and perform no incompatible state mutation.

failure_scenarios.trigger: network is absent or becomes unavailable during remote work
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Bound retries and queues, retain authoritative-state distinction, expose offline or local fallback, and reconcile explicitly after restoration.

failure_scenarios.trigger: persisted state fails integrity, schema, or decoding validation
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject the state, preserve trusted server authority, start from a safe bounded default, report redacted diagnostics, and avoid destructive overwrite until policy permits.

failure_scenarios.trigger: renderer transaction fails or returns malformed traffic
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject the transaction atomically, retain last valid generation or bounded fallback, isolate the root, report diagnostics, and release abandoned resources.

failure_scenarios.trigger: root or resource owner is disposed, replaced, or crashes
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Invalidate its generation, cancel pending work, release every lease idempotently, restore or redirect focus, and reject late completions.

failure_scenarios.trigger: browser runtime terminates or becomes unresponsive
failure_scenarios.required_outcome: Detect loss, stop accepting local mutations, dispose host-owned bridges, preserve safe fallback content, and perform only policy-authorized bounded restart.

release_blockers.condition: an owned lease, subscription, timer, surface, file, or effect survives terminal owner disposal
release_blockers.detection: Lifecycle inventory and repeated disposal traces identify a live resource after its cleanup bound.

release_blockers.condition: focus is irrecoverably lost after a supported mutation, failure, fallback, or surface close
release_blockers.detection: Keyboard and assistive-technology scenarios cannot identify the documented next focus target.

release_blockers.condition: repeatable retained process, memory, listener, handle, or resource growth exceeds its lifecycle budget
release_blockers.detection: Repeated lifecycle fixtures produce monotonic retained growth outside the recorded stable service set.

release_blockers.condition: component, renderer, effect, retry, or supervision work continues without bounded progress
release_blockers.detection: Watchdog and transition traces show repeated work with no accepted state or terminal failure.

release_blockers.condition: accepted user or authoritative state disappears without a surfaced failure or documented reconciliation
release_blockers.detection: Failure and recovery traces diverge from the accepted state ledger without an observable error.

release_blockers.condition: a non-idempotent or unauthorized operation is retried automatically
release_blockers.detection: Command traces show repeated authority-bearing execution without explicit policy and idempotency identity.

release_blockers.condition: event, renderer, command, effect, diagnostic, or resource queues can grow without a declared bound
release_blockers.detection: Overload fixtures exceed declared admission limits without coalescing, backpressure, rejection, or failure.

cross_cutting_gates.scope_statement: Every supported family, renderer, profile, rendering mode, fallback, and interaction path must preserve the claimed semantic and operable outcome.

requirements.normative_statement: Status, validation, loading, progress, route, surface, and asynchronous changes expose bounded announcements with no duplicate or stale generation output.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: A visible and programmatically determinable status remains available when live announcement is unsupported.

requirements.normative_statement: Every visual, permission-dependent, pointer-heavy, timed, virtualized, custom-scene, and chart claim provides an accessible fallback or an explicit unsupported state.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Absence of a usable fallback for a supported claim is a blocker and cannot be waived.

requirements.normative_statement: Pointer, touch, keyboard, direct-action, and nonvisual paths expose equivalent outcomes wherever the component claims those interaction modes.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Unsupported input modes are disclosed and an equivalent supported action remains reachable without pointer precision.

requirements.normative_statement: Keyboard operation, logical focus order, visible focus, trapping, restoration, and failure redirection follow the normalized semantic contract for every interactive path.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Unrecoverable focus loss or an unreachable supported action is a blocker and cannot be waived.

requirements.normative_statement: Role, accessible name, description, relationships, value, state, set position, hierarchy, errors, and required or disabled status match renderer-normalized assertions.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: A supported family without a programmatically determinable name, role, or required state fails its gate.

requirements.normative_statement: Content remains perceivable and operable under logical direction changes, two-hundred-percent zoom, reflow, forced colors, reduced motion, and text spacing variation.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: The classified static, nonanimated, high-contrast, or alternative-interaction fallback is applied without hiding required content.

severity_rules.blocker: No supported path, inaccessible authority-bearing action, unrecoverable focus, or missing essential semantics.
severity_rules.high: Major task is materially harder or fallback loses an interaction mode, announcement, or visual adaptation.
severity_rules.medium: Task remains possible but semantic, ordering, instruction, or adaptation quality is degraded.
severity_rules.low: Nonessential polish issue with no semantic ambiguity, lost content, blocked task, or repeated burden.

cross_cutting_gates.exception_policy: Blockers cannot be waived; lesser exceptions require one scoped family/profile, an accessible fallback, owner, mitigation, review, and expiry within one release.

cross_cutting_gates.scope_statement: Every runtime, browser, renderer, profile, package, manifest, schema, protocol, asset, and deployment combination must be identified and fail coherently when incompatible.

requirements.normative_statement: Runtime, host, renderer, profile, package, manifest, schema, protocol, asset, and deployment revisions carry independently inspectable compatibility identities.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: A missing required identity makes the composition unvalidated and prevents activation or release.

requirements.normative_statement: Every incompatible identity pair refuses partial activation before mutation and preserves intentional server, static, unsupported, or upgrade-required fallback content.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Mismatch produces a bounded diagnostic and no mixed-version state mutation, retry loop, or blank page.

requirements.normative_statement: Each release publishes exact tested browser windows, runtime and toolchain inputs, profile compositions, package ranges, known exclusions, and evidence freshness.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Untested or expired combinations remain candidate or unsupported and cannot inherit support from another profile.

requirements.normative_statement: Supported upgrade and rollback paths declare state, manifest, asset-cache, protocol, and package migration behavior with recovery from interrupted deployment.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Unsafe migration is refused before destructive state change and directs the operator or user to a bounded recovery path.

severity_rules.blocker: Composition can corrupt state, execute incompatible traffic, partially activate, or misstate supported compatibility.
severity_rules.high: Supported upgrade, rollback, browser, package, or profile path fails safely but cannot complete its documented outcome.
severity_rules.medium: Supported path completes with manual recovery, excess cache disruption, or incomplete compatibility diagnostics.
severity_rules.low: Compatibility metadata presentation issue that cannot alter resolution, activation, support, or recovery behavior.

cross_cutting_gates.exception_policy: No exception may permit mixed incompatible execution; candidate support exceptions require an explicit unsupported state, owner, mitigation, review, and expiry.

cross_cutting_gates.scope_statement: Every source pin, adapted implementation, license, notice, icon, style, example, generated artifact, and dependency entering a release must have complete auditable provenance.

requirements.normative_statement: Adapted or translated code records source revision, exact file or range, license, transformation, author, review, and whether the result enters a distributed artifact.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Untraceable adapted code is excluded from the release until provenance and license review are complete.

requirements.normative_statement: Icons, fonts, styles, examples, images, and other assets record creator, source, version, license, modification, attribution, and redistribution requirements.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: An asset with incomplete or incompatible rights is omitted or replaced before packaging.

requirements.normative_statement: Every direct and transitive dependency records resolved version, source, integrity, license, notice obligation, known risk disposition, and artifact reachability.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Unknown, unlicensed, disallowed, or critically vulnerable reachable dependencies block the owning package or release.

requirements.normative_statement: Generated artifacts identify generator revision, complete inputs, deterministic command, environment, output hash, ownership, and whether regeneration is byte-stable.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Stale or irreproducible generated output is rejected and cannot substitute for its authored source.

requirements.normative_statement: Every source inspiration or incorporated work records repository or publication identity, immutable revision, access date, license, notices, and approved use boundary.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Missing source or license identity blocks incorporation and leaves conceptual inspiration explicitly non-copying.

severity_rules.blocker: Release contains material with missing, incompatible, or prohibited rights, source, integrity, or critical risk disposition.
severity_rules.high: Required provenance is present but generated output, notice assembly, or dependency reachability is stale or irreproducible.
severity_rules.medium: Non-distributed evidence or metadata is incomplete without obscuring release rights, integrity, dependencies, or notices.
severity_rules.low: Presentation issue in otherwise complete provenance with no impact on attribution, rights, integrity, or reproducibility.

cross_cutting_gates.exception_policy: No exception may authorize unknown or incompatible rights; non-release metadata exceptions require owner, explicit exclusion, mitigation, review, and expiry.

cross_cutting_gates.scope_statement: Browser state and capability results remain untrusted; every authority-bearing command, artifact, dependency, origin, and diagnostic path must fail closed and remain auditable.

requirements.normative_statement: Capability grants are least-privilege, purpose-bound, owner-bound, cancellable, time-bounded where appropriate, opaque to portable code, and revocable on generation change.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Denied or revoked grants use the classified fallback, expose no provider object, and release provisional resources.

requirements.normative_statement: All browser state, component messages, renderer traffic, persisted values, capability results, and presentation authorization are validated as untrusted inputs.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Malformed or unauthorized input is rejected before trusted mutation with bounded redacted diagnostics.

requirements.normative_statement: State-changing server requests enforce authenticated session, authorization, anti-CSRF policy, allowed origin, content type, replay policy, and bounded request size.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: A failed boundary check performs no command and returns a non-sensitive intentional error.

requirements.normative_statement: Reachable dependencies pass governed risk policy and diagnostics redact secrets, tokens, personal data, file contents, opaque handles, and sensitive server responses.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Critical reachable risk or sensitive diagnostic disclosure blocks release until removed, mitigated, or explicitly excluded from reachability.

requirements.normative_statement: Client reachability excludes secrets and server-only configuration while deployed code and assets use content integrity, restrictive CSP, safe content handling, and authenticated update metadata.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: A secret-bearing, integrity-unknown, policy-bypassing, or unsafe-content artifact is excluded and activation fails closed.

requirements.normative_statement: Every authority-bearing command is authenticated, authorized against current server state, schema-validated, idempotency-classified, audited, and independent of client presentation state.
requirements.fallback_or_failure: Unauthorized, stale, malformed, or replayed commands perform no authority-bearing mutation and expose a bounded failure.

severity_rules.blocker: Authority, confidentiality, integrity, isolation, command validation, secret exclusion, or fail-closed behavior can be bypassed.
severity_rules.high: Defense-in-depth, auditability, revocation, dependency, or redaction control is materially incomplete without demonstrated exploitation.
severity_rules.medium: Security control works but diagnostics, policy coverage, or operational response is incomplete or fragile.
severity_rules.low: Security documentation or non-sensitive diagnostic quality issue with no control, authority, or disclosure impact.

cross_cutting_gates.exception_policy: No exception may bypass authentication, authorization, origin/CSRF, secret exclusion, command validation, integrity, or critical dependency policy; lesser exceptions expire within one release.
